checks.test_first_failures: Observed native unknown-method failures and missing compiled-Wasm NFT exports before implementation; strict token-id regression failed before correction. Native and compiled-Wasm same-account reviewer tests failed before the creator/reviewer distinction guard.

limitations: Compiled Wasm tests use transactional host doubles, not NEAR Sandbox.
Deployment retains external full-access control until separately verified.
Five campaign slots are owner-controlled; one hundred participant slots are finite.
Callback failure leaves a withdrawal pending; no timeout-based recredit.
NFT receiver and resolver gas is unmeasured in the NEAR protocol runtime.
A failed NFT resolver leaves earlier receiver ownership in place; no pending ownership lock or timeout clawback exists.
NFT ownership controls only a discovery mirror; every ownership change resets it to the immutable original manifest URI.
An older NFT callback may return a token reacquired by its original receiver; the resolver follows reference owner-equality semantics, not transfer nonces.
Distinct creator and reviewer account IDs do not prove different controllers or prevent collusion.
